name: kilo-priority
description: VS Code UI for per-machine LiteLLM request priority used by Kilo Code

commands.title: Kilo Priority: Disable Tagging on This Machine
Kilo Priority: Reveal Sidecar Config File

kiloPriority.enabled.description: Add a LiteLLM "priority" field to requests for matching gateway providers. Off = requests bypass LiteLLM's priority queue entirely. Machine-scoped: never synced across machines.

kiloPriority.priority.description: LiteLLM priority number. Lower wins (work=1, personal=5). Must be >= 1: LiteLLM treats 0 as untagged. Machine-scoped on purpose — do not sync this across machines.

kiloPriority.targets.description: Lowercase substrings matched against the provider ID, provider name, and baseURL. An empty array tags nothing.
